why: Case 2 of the four: `ApiErrorBody` derived `Deserialize` on the FLAT shape while every Laravel handler in this backend nests the code one level down, under `errors`. The result was `code: None` on every single real refusal. This fixture is the nested envelope, recorded from the one refusal a test can trigger deterministically and cheaply.

errors.message: Push toplu istegi izin verilen sinirin uzerinde.

server.note: The backend consumer posts MAX_BATCH + 1 mutations and asserts the shape of what comes back: HTTP 422, an `errors` object, and `errors.code` equal to the value above. The MESSAGE is not compared - it is a translated string and pinning it here would turn a locale edit into a red wire test.
